identity.description: GoHighLevel (HighLevel, also branded LeadConnector) is an all-in-one marketing/CRM platform; its public API docs describe the 'HighLevel CRM platform'.
identity.identity_notes: Assignment URL highlevel.stoplight.io returned no usable content (only the word 'Stoplight'). Identity established from HighLevel's own developer marketplace docs; GoHighLevel and HighLevel are used interchangeably across the sources. Official marketing website was not fetched.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization Code Grant (v2 APIs); PKCE/S256 not currently supported for the Marketplace app installation flow
auth.token_refresh: Access token expires after 86,399 seconds (~24h); refresh token valid up to one year or until used, and each use returns a new refresh token that invalidates the old one
auth.scopes_notes: Private Integration tokens can be limited to specific scopes; select only the required scopes.

access.production_restrictions: Private apps are limited to 5 unique Agency installs; to unblock more installs, publish as Public (listed) or request Security Review (available after 6+ Agencies).

api.rate_limits: Burst limit of 100 API requests per 10 seconds per app per resource; daily cap of 200,000 requests per day (from search summary of official rate-limits page; not verified on page)
api.limitations: Per-operation read/write detail not verified on official pages; 'Broad' rests on the landing page's 'Complete REST API documentation' claim and a secondary source citing 550+ operations via MCP. SDK existence conflicting. Webhook delivery retries only on HTTP 429 per a Freshdesk support article.

open_questions: Assignment URL highlevel.stoplight.io returned no usable content; it could not be confirmed as the source of truth.
Whether a free sandbox, trial, or paid plan is needed to create an agency account and test credentials is not stated; free_credentials and paid_plan_required remain unknown.
Per-operation read/write endpoint lists were not verified; the official rate-limit page was not fetched directly (values came from search summary).

Official SDK existence is unconfirmed: the glossary says an SDK exists, the landing page only references SDKs in quick-start, and the GitHub docs repo lists no packages. Lead: github.com/gohighlevel/highlevel-api-php appeared in search but was not opened.

Official MCP tool count conflicts: docs page describes four tools (list_locations, search_operations, describe_operation, execute_operation); a search summary cites 550+ operations via unified tools and a 36-tool token-based variant. Whether the token-based server still exists is unverified.
Community MCP repos (drausal, hridayshah7, busybee3333, CryptoJym, mastanley13) were judged from search snippets only; none opened or verified for maintenance status.
Stoplight hint vs official docs: unclear whether highlevel.stoplight.io is an official mirror of marketplace.gohighlevel.com docs.

assessment.approach: Wrap/benchmark vendor's official MCP server; add managed auth
rationale: A workspace admin must approve/install or issue credentials.
